copy.about: SILO Brooklyn is a club at 90 Scott Avenue in Bushwick. It describes itself as a space to dance, hear music and express yourself, with no tolerance for harassment, bigotry or unwanted contact, and trained staff who will remove anyone making others feel unsafe. Its front room lounge runs Open Decks on Wednesdays and, most Thursdays, a DJ night with a local collective, most of them free with an RSVP on DICE.

rules.label: ID
rules.text: 21+ unless a night says otherwise; bring a government photo ID or passport.

rules.label: Re-entry
rules.text: Usually allowed, but exits can be final at a sold-out show when the venue is at capacity. Smokers use a designated area outside the side door and get back in with a stamp.

rules.label: Coat check
rules.text: Yes, a paid coat check, cash or card.

rules.label: Accessibility
rules.text: The main entrance at 90 Scott Avenue and every space, including the stage, are wheelchair accessible; reserved seating can be arranged by email (a11y@silobrooklyn.com). Restrooms are gender neutral, with two accessible stalls.

rules.label: Door tickets
rules.text: Sold at the door on a first-come, first-served basis when available; all ticket sales are final.

rules.label: Strobes and haze
rules.text: Ticketed nights are loud and use strobe lights and haze.

p_src: venue FAQ on its DICE listings

copy.about: Elsewhere is a multi-room club and venue at 599 Johnson Avenue in Bushwick, with rooms its listings call the Hall, Zone One and the Loft, plus a courtyard. It describes itself as a community that values inclusivity, joy and creativity, with a zero-tolerance policy for harassment, discrimination or hate, and asks for a present dance floor, with phones and photos kept to the courtyard.

rules.label: ID
rules.text: A physical, valid, scannable US government ID or a foreign passport. Expired IDs, photocopies and photos of IDs are not accepted; travelers should bring a physical passport.

rules.label: Refunds
rules.text: Ticket sales are final except when a night is cancelled. Openers, set times and the room a night is in can change without notice.

rules.label: Phones
rules.text: Phones and photos belong in the courtyard, not on the dance floor.

p_src: venue FAQ on its DICE listings

copy.about: Somewhere Nowhere NYC is a rooftop and indoor lounge at 112 West 25th Street in Chelsea, with day parties and night events. Its listings set a strict dress code and entry rules, and table reservations are sold as a minimum spend on food and drink.

rules.label: ID
rules.text: 21+ with a valid government photo ID. The card used to buy the ticket and a matching photo ID must be shown at the door by the cardholder, or entry is refused without a refund.

rules.label: Dress code
rules.text: Upscale, fashion-forward attire is required. No dirty sneakers, sportswear, sport caps, sweatpants, shorts, tank tops, sandals, slides, ripped jeans or plain white tees; the door host has the final say.

rules.label: Re-entry
rules.text: No re-entry once you leave.

rules.label: Refunds
rules.text: All purchases are non-refundable and non-exchangeable.

rules.label: Bags
rules.text: All bags are subject to a security check; no outside food or drink.

p_src: venue FAQ on its DICE listings

copy.about: House of Yes is a club and performance venue at 2 Wyckoff Avenue in Bushwick. It sells group and table packages by email or WhatsApp, and keeps a full FAQ on its own site.

rules.label: Door tickets
rules.text: Yes, tickets are sold at the door until the venue reaches capacity; it suggests coming early.

rules.label: Groups
rules.text: Group and celebration packages are booked through reservations@houseofyes.org.

p_src: venue FAQ on its DICE listings

copy.about: The Onyx Room at House of Yes, at 8 Wyckoff Avenue in Bushwick, hosts its own nights. Groups are encouraged to book a table with drinks included through House of Yes reservations.

rules.label: Door tickets
rules.text: Limited tickets are sold at the door until capacity; come early.

rules.label: Groups
rules.text: Table reservations with drinks are booked through reservations@houseofyes.org, giving the event name and date.

p_src: venue FAQ on its DICE listings

copy.about: Superior Ingredients is a venue at 74 Wythe Avenue in Williamsburg with a Main Room and the Roof, which its listings describe as enclosed by a fully retractable glass roof and climate-controlled, so rooftop events go ahead rain or shine.

rules.label: Weather
rules.text: The Roof is enclosed in retractable glass and climate-controlled; events run rain or shine.

rules.label: Coat check
rules.text: Yes, bag and coat check are available.

rules.label: Food
rules.text: Food is often available on site; options vary by event.

p_src: venue FAQ on its DICE listings

copy.about: The Sultan Room is a venue at 234 Starr Street in Bushwick, mostly standing room with a little first-come seating and a rooftop, next door to its sister restaurant Turks Inn. It describes itself as an inclusive space that welcomes everyone and removes anyone who is not respectful.

rules.label: ID
rules.text: 21+ unless the show says otherwise; a government-issued, unexpired ID is required and photos of IDs are not accepted.

rules.label: Accessibility
rules.text: Entry ramps and ADA bathrooms; questions to info@thesultanroom.com.

rules.label: Coat check
rules.text: Seasonal, closed in summer. Large bags are inspected, and late club nights and sold-out shows have a mandatory bag check.

rules.label: Smoking
rules.text: No smoking or vaping inside; there is a smoking section on the rooftop, away from the roof bar.

rules.label: Photos
rules.text: Phones and simple cameras for personal use are fine; no flash and no professional cameras.

rules.label: Refunds
rules.text: All sales are final, except within one hour of purchase or when a show is rescheduled or cancelled.

p_src: venue FAQ on its DICE listings

copy.about: C'mon Everybody is a bar and venue at 325 Franklin Avenue in Brooklyn, with a dance floor and a lounge. Its listings say the entrance, bar, dance floor and bathroom are wheelchair accessible, with two booths kept for ADA seating.

rules.label: ID
rules.text: 21+; photos of IDs or passports are not accepted.

rules.label: Accessibility
rules.text: The entrance, exits, bar, dance floor and bathroom are wheelchair accessible, with two dedicated ADA booths in the lounge.

rules.label: Coat check
rules.text: Seasonal, closed in the summer months.

rules.label: Refunds
rules.text: Ticket sales are final unless the organizer cancels or reschedules.

p_src: venue FAQ on its DICE listings

copy.about: Knockdown Center is a large warehouse venue at 52-19 Flushing Avenue in Maspeth, Queens. It sets age limits per event and checks ID strictly.

rules.label: ID
rules.text: Any US state-issued photo ID or an original passport is accepted as proof of age.

p_src: venue FAQ on its DICE listings

copy.about: Xanadu is a roller rink and club at 262 Starr Street in Bushwick, right off the Jefferson Street L stop, open only for events: skate sessions, live shows and club nights. On its club nights there is a skate session from 7 to 10pm, then the rink closes for skating and opens for dancing.

rules.label: ID
rules.text: 21+ unless a night says otherwise; a valid government photo ID or passport is required.

rules.label: Accessibility
rules.text: All entrances and spaces are single-level, with a ramp at the main entrance; email info@xanadu.nyc when you buy a ticket to arrange accommodations. Strobes may be used.

rules.label: Coat check
rules.text: Lockers for rent, hooks and cubbies; coat check at large shows.

rules.label: Smoking
rules.text: No smoking or vaping inside; an outdoor smoking area on select evenings.

rules.label: Waiver
rules.text: A waiver is required whenever skating happens; not for shoes-only club nights.

rules.label: Refunds
rules.text: Ticket sales are final unless the organizer cancels or reschedules.
